scenes.world: The fog-bound shore under a dead grey sky, armoured dead walking out of the mist, grainy epic black and white, wind only.

captain.asks: Sheets of the past: a track along Troy's dead walking out of the mist together, armoured, epic, wind only.
diagnosis: There are no warriors anywhere: athletes in shorts, a bather in a singlet, a park walk; the epic is a sports reel.
Fog plates hold the world but carry ten-second shots of nothing; Achilles' great speech plays over a blank sky.
The young-man face close-ups are the one usable thread; hold one face for Achilles or the exchange is unattributed.

sign.name: Sheets of the past
sign.operation: Long track across the punishment landscape.

scenes.world: A barren grey wasteland of rock and fog beyond the shore, scorched and lifeless, grainy black and white.

captain.asks: Sheets of the past: one long track across the punishment landscape, figures fixed in their torments as the camera passes.
diagnosis: The rocky wasteland is consistent bw and genuinely lifeless; the landscape the sign wants is on the reel.
Torments are only half there: a bent figure on a slope does double duty as Sisyphus; Minos, Orion, Tantalus, Heracles never appear.
The flight ends on a tinted red canoe and blank grey; the crowd of dead and the fear have no image at all.

prologue: Still telling his story, Odysseus describes his journey to the land of the dead. He goes to ask a dead prophet how to get home. There he also meets the ghosts of people he loved and soldiers he fought beside.
